svg.aria-label: H100 memory hierarchy: 132 streaming multiprocessors with registers and shared memory, a 50 MB L2 cache, and 80 GB of HBM at 3.35 TB/s
svg.text: L2 cache · 50 MB, shared by all SMs
Bigger memory is slower memory: kilobytes of fast SRAM inside each SM, 80 GB of HBM outside. NVIDIA H100 SXM figures.
